claim_boundary: Static blind-journey transcript contract: validator success defines auditability of one committed operator-visible transcript only; it claims no installed usefulness, no candidate qualification, no blind acceptance and no release verdict.
limitations: synthetic fixture packets cannot qualify a candidate; the #4604 execution lane must supply a real immutable-candidate run
semantic answer-leak review requires a named human reviewer verdict over the exact prompt and separately stored answer key; the mechanical scan alone cannot establish semantic blindness
event input/output digests are optional in this contract version: when present they must be well-formed SHA-256 hex, but per-kind presence requirements are deferred to the #4604 execution slice
public docs/help inputs in the corpus are synthetic; #4508 owns the real deterministic journey input corpus
candidate/process/artifact admission is referenced, not owned; #4510 stays the admission authority
combinations_not_exercised: a real operator/model session against public docs and help (#4508)
the #4510 candidate/process harness consuming this contract in hosted CI
a terminal result of instrument_failure, which requires a broken or absent packet rather than a parseable one
